verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt (HTTP 200) on developers.cloudflare.com, the first-party docs site that hosts the Sandbox documentation, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the probed per-page markdown variant of the Sandbox get-started page returned 404. missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt indexes Sandbox pages specifically, working per-page markdown docs, sandbox-specific agent-oriented docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
